attrs.title: What it’s like to work with us
Meta Lead Ads Setup questions, answered
attrs.lead: Can’t find your answer? Ask us on a free 30-minute call.

items.question: How do I send Facebook leads to my CRM?
items.answer: Connect the form to your CRM through Meta’s integrations, a native connector (HubSpot, Salesforce) or a tool like Zapier. Leads then arrive in seconds.

items.question: How do I improve Facebook lead quality?
items.answer: Use higher-intent forms, add qualifying questions and send lead outcomes from your CRM back to Meta so it learns which leads are good.

items.question: What is the lead ads testing tool?
items.answer: A Meta tool that creates a test lead, so you can check it reaches your CRM before going live.
